YunYin Score 2.0 — third-party notices

Offline image text recognition uses Tesseract4Android 4.9.0
https://github.com/adaptech-cz/Tesseract4Android
Apache License 2.0; see tess_license.txt.
The native package includes Tesseract OCR and Leptonica, libjpeg and libpng.
See the corresponding bundled license files for copyright and license terms.

English LSTM fast model (eng.traineddata):
https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast
Apache License 2.0; see traineddata_license.txt.

Leptonica:
https://github.com/DanBloomberg/leptonica
See leptonica_license.txt (BSD-style license).

JPEG 9f: This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group.
https://www.ijg.org/
See libjpeg_license.txt (the complete README from the JPEG 9f distribution).

libpng 1.6.48:
https://github.com/pnggroup/libpng
See libpng_license.txt.

Online score directory and downloads:
https://musetrainer.github.io/library/
The directory describes its collection as Public Domain MusicXML files.
The app preserves the actual download URL in each saved library entry.
The source directory is cached for offline browsing; downloading a score needs Internet.

Image recognition and music conversion are assistance for user review.
No recorded song audio, PCM playback, cloud OCR or paid recognition API is bundled.
